'''Tass root''',<ref name="Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> also known simply as '''tass''', was a kind of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> When powdered,<ref name="Rule of Two" /> mixed with the [[Flower/Legends|flowers]] from the [[scintil vine]], and dampened with [[Water/Legends|water]], it formed a highly corrosive paste that could eat through rock and [[Metal/Legends|metal]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> In [[990 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The part of ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' that includes [[Darovit]]'s [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] is set ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|end]] of the [[Ruusan campaign]], which '''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Therefore, the sabotage must have occurred in [[990 BBY]].</ref> [[Darovit]], a [[Hermit/Legends|hermit]] living on Ruusan, used the paste to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the construction of a monument being built in the [[Valley of the Jedi]] to honor the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] who [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] their lives to [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|destroy]] the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="Rule of Two" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tass root first appeared in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] as the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Rule of Two" /> The plant was identified only as tass in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" />
